Title: Record baseline and recovery map
Acceptance criteria: 355 offline tests, pip check and static build pass; current scope and history mapped.

Title: Verify local Story demo in desktop and mobile
Acceptance criteria: Browser smoke checks pass; create/edit/history/demo labels and no mobile overflow.
Evidence or blocker: 10 desktop/mobile browser checks passed in explicit local demo; zero paid model calls, 2026-11-15

Title: Verify protected hosted web configuration
Acceptance criteria: Separate Render web service, durable storage, one worker, exact origin, deployed SHA; owner-preview health and unauthenticated 401 verified.
Evidence or blocker: No dashboard credentials or deployment changes in this cleanup

Title: Run and rate 10 real Story requests
Acceptance criteria: BRIEF PoC gate met; request IDs, source verification, ratings, time and costs recorded.
Evidence or blocker: Needs protected service, private provider settings and explicit total test budget

Title: Verify live edit/history/restart/idempotency
Acceptance criteria: One reviewed edit, history reopen, duplicate submit and restart recovery demonstrated.
Evidence or blocker: Offline coverage exists; live evidence pending

Title: Fix the most frequent measured Story failure
Acceptance criteria: Reproduction, minimal fix and regression; owner rerates failing example successfully.
Evidence or blocker: Choose specific failure from live results; do not speculate

Title: Measure cost and latency per useful script
Acceptance criteria: Record accepted rate, editing effort, p50/p95 latency and actual provider cost; agree targets.
Evidence or blocker: Price tables/model identifiers require live validation

Title: Record owner MVP acceptance decision
Acceptance criteria: Owner records pass/fail against BRIEF gate; unresolved blockers have cards.
Evidence or blocker: CW-06 may be closed with evidence no fix needed

Title: Review proposed creator schema and isolation
Acceptance criteria: Feedback ownership, job states/idempotency, voice versions and two-user isolation defined/tested before migration.

Title: Implement invite-only identity and private jobs
Acceptance criteria: Backend verifies identity; two accounts cannot read/update each other; history migration and rollback tested.

Title: Implement approved creator voice end to end
Acceptance criteria: Collect examples; approve version; writer/reviewer/editor/adviser use same private profile.
Evidence or blocker: Do not mix shared dialect with private creator voice

Title: Verify operations and retention for beta
Acceptance criteria: Durable jobs, quotas, safe errors, restart/rollback, deletion and operator metrics verified.
Evidence or blocker: Remain single process until job ownership supports concurrency

Title: Run 60-case human acceptance evaluation
Acceptance criteria: Existing beta gates measured: 95% technical completion, 80% human 4/5 ratings; critical issues resolved.
Evidence or blocker: Add one new format only after Story passes

Title: Run seven-day invited pilot
Acceptance criteria: 5–10 invited creators; daily feedback/cost/incident review; expansion decision recorded.

Title: Evaluate pooled learning proposal
Acceptance criteria: Separate consent, scrubbing, withdrawal and deletion demonstrated before any pooling.
Evidence or blocker: Defer; not needed to prove product

Title: Consider physical Python package reorganization
Acceptance criteria: Only if justified: import checks, one module boundary per PR, deployment compatibility preserved.
Evidence or blocker: Current cleanup maps paths without moving runtime files
